status: frozen before any step-6 code or evaluation
test_set: TUNE blocks of step2/holdout_v7.json (12 h, 2 h warm-up inside the block). TUNE was used as test set by Steps 3-5 and for structure checks in Step 2, so it is not untouched; it is the largest set never used for fitting any parameter. The integrated test is new (coupled simulation) and no parameter is changed in Step 6.

component_consistency_max_abs_c.description: plant_v1 reproduces each step's component model output when fed that step's measured inputs

cpp_parity_max_abs_c.description: C++ header vs Python plant on the parity input set

coupled_tinc_rmse_c.description: open-loop coupled T_incoming sensor, fresh samples

coupled_tfwd_rmse_c.description: open-loop coupled T_forward sensor, floor pump on >= 5 min, no DHW

closed_loop_tfwd_mean_abs_diff_c.description: legacy-controller replica in closed loop: |mean simulated - mean measured T_forward| over samples with floor pump on >= 30 min, no DHW, boiler firing in the last 10 min

closed_loop_pos_mean_abs_diff_pct.description: same samples: |mean simulated - mean measured mixer position|

rationale: Coupled thresholds allow the component errors of Steps 2-5 to accumulate (about the root-sum of the component RMSEs plus margin). The closed-loop gates check that the plant reproduces the legacy controller's operating point, which is what a HIL test of the new controller relies on.
